Name: Immersive Barns and Coops
Author: nuupon
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/QgZsM7L.png[/img]﻿
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Lo11BgZ.png[/img]﻿[/center][center]﻿[/center][center]
I originally made this for personal use, but after receiving help from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/18790269]mushymato[/url] and several others, I decided to polish and upload this mod as my own!

I missed the way barns worked in Harvest Moon, where each animal had a designated hay feeder, and I like having my barns and coops look organized and realistic, and I loved my chicken's ground feeder. So with this mod, barn animals will only spawn in their stables, optionally have individual feeders, and for the coop animals they should only spawn near their nesting boxes. They will wander if there is no fence!

Please be sure to use [url=https://github.com/Lake1059/ResetTerrainFeatures_NET6]ResetTerrainFeatures[/url] if you have issues with placement.
And definitely sleep a day once installing before reporting any issues.﻿

This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423?tab=description]Misc Map Action Properties[/url] otherwise your barn animals will stack on top of each other.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hsr7nmD.png[/img]

[b]This mod does not include its own recolor, it is just the map.

Stardew Valley Expanded Premiums included.
Custom Coop Animals will work.
Custom Barn Animals will work.﻿
[/b][b]Animals Need Water patch in optional files.
(ANW does not work with SVE Premiums)

...if somebody wishes to make compatibility patch feel free.[/b]

For the fences, I did not include it in the map setup as I figured most would want to use their own fences, so you can set them up how I have laid them out here. Eggs will only spawn in the nesting areas as seen here! And barn animals will spawn only in their stables!

And for the custom feeders they are entirely functional and even work with the third upgrade autohoppers.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xJut7PW.png[/img]﻿[/center][img]https://i.imgur.com/MhlgrHt.png[/img]
